description: Adds an empty-hand climb mode for vertical ropes in Create: Aeronautics. Right-click with bare hands to grab on, W/S to climb, Space to jump off, Sneak to let go.

mods.name: Climbable Ropes for Create Aeronautics
mods.description: Addon for Create: Aeronautics (Simulated module). Adds empty-hand climb modes for hanging rope strands and plunger ropes, plus a wrench-zipline mode for plunger ropes. The original Simulated zipline on hanging ropes is left untouched. The mod runs on both client and dedicated server: the server owns climbing config (auto-synced to clients) and tracks rope-riding state; per-tick climb input is handled client-side.

releases.notes:
## Version 2.2.0

### Changed
- Replaced the pre-made climbing animations with a procedural climbing pose that adapts to any rope angle: hands grip the rope, feet lock around it and the legs push while climbing
- Players now crawl along flat and sagging ropes with the new climbing pose instead of Create's hanging pose
- The mod no longer requires the Player Animator library
